purpose: Teach: 追記/新装/賞与/取り調べ/動員/次期/顕著/買い付け

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、契約書に、絶対、追記、絶対、自分で、絶対、考えたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In those early days, I made sure your father thought deeply about every contract addendum himself. I asked him seriously to do that.
lines.style: Measured, quiet authority. Lean forward slightly on the memory. Weight on each clause. Pause between thoughts like selecting words from long experience. Voice steady and unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、本社の、絶対、新装、絶対、機会、絶対、何度かありました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, we've had several occasions to renew the headquarters. I'm truly grateful for that.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Nod in the voice itself. Warm acknowledgment without excess. Even pacing, slight emphasis on 「感謝」 as genuine gratitude, not ceremonial.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、社員の、絶対、賞与、絶対、自分で、絶対、配ったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father distributed bonuses to the staff himself. He made sure to do that personally — I asked him to understand the weight of that.
lines.style: Nostalgic, tender. Slight opening breath. Slower pace on 「自分で」. Wistful trailing at the end, like watching something precious recede. Quiet respect beneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、本気で、絶対、お得意様の、絶対、取り調べ、絶対、当時、絶対、関わったと、絶対、聞いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I heard that your father was personally involved in overseeing our valued clients back then. I'm deeply grateful for what he taught us.
lines.style: Reflective, measured. Light pause before 「聞いております」. Warm but not casual — speaking of something significant. Steady respect in the voice, not performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、動員、絶対、して、絶対、大事業、絶対、進めたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father mobilized the staff himself and pushed forward on major projects. That's what I asked him to carry — the weight of those decisions.
lines.style: Nostalgic, reverent. Slightly breathier on 「動員」. Slow, deliberate pacing. Small pause after each clause. Voice carries memory and gratitude equally. Trailing fadeout on the final gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、次期、絶対、社長、絶対、として、絶対、私を、絶対、選んでくださいました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Your father chose me to succeed him as the next president. I've never forgotten that trust, and I'm profoundly grateful.
lines.style: Quiet, tender sincerity. Gentle emphasis on 「選んでくださいました」. Slower pace, almost vulnerable. Voice steady but warm — acknowledgment of both gift and responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、顕著、絶対、な、絶対、業績、絶対、いつも、絶対、出してきたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father consistently produced marked results. He always delivered — I asked him to carry that standard.
lines.style: Measured, slightly nostalgic. Firm conviction on 「顕著」. Slower pace throughout. Voice carries respect and something like wistfulness for that era. Slight trailing on the final clause.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、原材料の、絶対、買い付け、絶対、お父さん、絶対、目利き、絶対、お見事でした、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, his eye for sourcing raw materials was remarkable. His judgment was truly splendid, and I'm grateful for that legacy.
lines.style: Warm, respectful close. Emphasis on 「お見事でした」 with genuine appreciation. Slower, almost reflective pace. Voice carries both admiration and closure. Gentle fadeout at the end.
